messages:
nina: quick thread to lock GA acceptance for Realtime Lite. goal: one-page checklist we can sign off today — SLA floors, monitoring gates, rollout plan, support handoff, pricing pilot. assign owners?

sam: i'll take SLA + alerting. propose gating: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 900ms, error_rate < 0.5% sustained over 30m.

lee: ops will own rollout & runbook. canary plan: 3% for 1h, 20% for 3h, 100% if all green. need oncall rota for first 72h and automated smoke tests.

tara: docs will ship internal runbook + customer FAQ. need sample failure traces and exact alert names to link.

finance: will draft pilot pricing (4 weeks) with discount note. confirm billing stays per-token for GA.

infra-bot: Canary window reserved by @lee for Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC — automated promotion enabled.

sam: adding Prometheus rule now. snippet: ALERT RealtimeLite_P95 IF histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(req_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.3 FOR 10m

lee: smoke matrix: auth check, short prompt, streaming path, cache warm vs cold. if pass -> promote to 20%.

tara: i'll add curl examples and support templates. target PR by 16:00 UTC.

nina: acceptance items to sign off: alerts live & tested, runbook linked, rota staffed, pricing PR, docs merged, smoke green for 6h. owners: SLA=sam, ops=lee, docs=tara, pricing=finance. any blockers?

sam: small model perf tweak in progress, will validate in canary and post metrics.

finance: waiting on sample usage from product to finalize numbers; will push draft by EOD.

nina: thanks team — short sync in 2h to confirm PR links. if all green we handshake tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
